//: Goals of the town's people (09 §3.2) beside those of `ai/goals.json` and `ai/routine_goals.json`. Everything is read from what the character believes: its tracks and memories, its relations, its own routine.
doc: Answering a call for help one heard: a member of the watch remembers it as `core:help_called` (the rule `core:heed_help`), and goes to where it came from, looks round and lets it be. Whoever it finds fighting there, `confront` deals with.
When a brawler last picked a fight, in seconds of universal time.
Picking a fight while drinking: once in a while, and never twice in ten minutes, someone standing close by is told off and taken for an enemy; `confront` does the rest.

track.where: (self.last_seen(it) ?? 99) < 2 and (dist(self, self.believed_loc(it)) ?? 99) < 3 and not self.hostile(it) and not self.fears(it)

score: if self.routine_doing == 'drinking' and not (self.routine_away ?? true) and now() - self.var.picked_fight_at > 600 and chance(0.02) then self.weight('temper') * 2 else 0

doc: Keeping near the one it is loyal to (the relation `core:loyal`), while it is fairly sure where they are.
When a dog last barked, in seconds of universal time.
Barking at someone close by that it is not loyal to: a stranger. At most once in half a minute: barks, watches them a few seconds, and lets them be until it next sees them come.

track.where: (self.rel('core:loyal', it) ?? 0) <= 0 and (self.last_seen(it) ?? 99) < 2 and (dist(self, self.believed_loc(it)) ?? 99) < 5 and not self.fears(it)

score: if now() - self.var.barked_at > 30 then 0.4 * self.weight('curiosity') else 0
